articles.title: Coinbase's Base blockchain resumes after two-hour outage disrupted network
articles.snippet: The incident temporarily halted transaction processing on one of Ethereum's largest layer-2 networks.

articles.title: Strategy's yield-generating STRC stock is more correlated with BTC than ever
articles.snippet: The tightening correlation undermines STRC's appeal as a relatively steadier income vehicle.

articles.title: Kraken in talks to buy 15% stake in DeFi lender Aave at $385 million valuation
articles.snippet: The DeFi lender is rebuilding after the fallout from April's KelpDAO exploit sparked a multibillion-dollar exodus of deposits despite Aave itself not being hacked.

articles.title: a16z-backed crypto firm rebrands, shifts focus to solving AI’s global copyright headache
articles.snippet: The startup formerly known as Story Protocol raised $140 million to secure internet rights and is now building an audit layer for data consent, licensing, and provenance for tech firms.

articles.title: BlackBerry is making a massive comeback as an 'uncrashable' software layer for AI and robotics
articles.snippet: BlackBerry's stock is surging after the company's massive earnings beat and is pivoting into becoming a critical component of the AI and robotics boom.
